summary: Server-side boost entity data that changes an item's use boosts (the boosts its eoc::UseComponent applies on use): the list of boost descriptions, the boost source, the boost parameters and a flag. Written by esv::StatsSystem::UpdateUseBoostRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x1047330, game ~bg3.exe+0x31C3A60) from a request element (stride 0x40), cleared by esv::StatsSystem::ClearChangeUseBoostsRequests; esv::BoostSystem::Initialize connects a signal on it. Never seen alive. Registry total 72 (client and server rows).

fields.name: Boost
fields.evidence: Same members as SE eoc::BoostDescription (Base/ExposedTypes.h, 3 FixedStrings); the Toolkit assert names ls::IndexedStorage<struct eoc::BoostDescription> and the stride is 0xC.

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: SE BoostSource.Type (enum BoostSourceType, 1 byte); bg3.exe creator writes byte 0 at component +0x10.

fields.name: Cause
fields.evidence: SE BoostSource.Cause; creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF at +0x14, destructor DecRefs +0x14.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: SE BoostSource.Entity; creator writes the null handle constant DAT_146174970 at +0x18.

fields.name: Status
fields.evidence: SE BoostSource.Status (ComponentHandle, 8 bytes); creator writes 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF at +0x20.

fields.name: Owner
fields.evidence: SE BoostParameters.Owner (Base/ExposedTypes.h); creator copies a 16-byte constant (DAT_14625aad0, the null Guid) to +0x28.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: SE BoostParameters.field_10; creator writes byte 0 at +0x38.

fields.name: _Pad11
fields.evidence: padding to 8-byte alignment (Toolkit copies +0x38 as a whole qword).

fields.name: Boosts
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x31D1BD0 (AllocRaw 0x48) zeroes pointer + capacity/size at 0..0xF. Destructor bg3.exe+0xD79980 calls bg3.exe+0x6DAFC0(p,0) (walks elements with stride 0xC) and frees the buffer. Toolkit UpdateUseBoostRequests destroys each eoc::BoostDescription (stride 0xC), reallocates (AllocateInternal(n, 0xC, 4)) and copies the request's array into component+0.

fields.name: Source
fields.evidence: Toolkit UpdateUseBoostRequests: eoc::BoostSource::operator=((BoostSource*)(p + 0x10), request + 8). Equals SE BoostSource (Base/ExposedTypes.h, 24 bytes); bg3.exe creator defaults match (Type 0, Cause null, Entity null, Status -1).

fields.name: Params
fields.evidence: Toolkit copies request qwords 4,5 to component +0x28/+0x30 and qword 6 to +0x38: a Guid followed by a byte - SE BoostParameters {Guid Owner; uint8_t field_10} (24 bytes with padding). bg3.exe creator: null Guid at +0x28, byte 0 at +0x38.

fields.name: field_40
fields.evidence: bg3.exe creator writes byte 1 at +0x40; Toolkit copies the request's byte at +0x38 (`*(u8*)(p+0x40) = *(u8*)(req+0x38)`).
